title: Exhaustive JVM 318 Bounded queue responses and final contents
description: Accepting a full offer by evicting the oldest value can change the acknowledgment while preserving the final queue. Certify the complete integer envelope of each frozen claim, run its actual guard and assertion with fresh application classes at each input, compare the direct data to its oracle, and replay any witness on a separate JVM.
expected: Every admitted point is accounted for and each declared disposition agrees with the independently checked byte-bound certificate.
